description: Fetch one web page through a product's proxy, so the request leaves from that product's IPs and targeting: status, final URL (up to 5 redirects), title, and the page as readable text or raw HTML, cut at 50,000 characters. Each call gets a new exit IP. Uses the product's bandwidth for the bytes transferred; binary files are not read.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. us. Leave every location field empty to use the targeting saved in the dashboard.

format.description: text: readable text, with scripts, styles and tags removed. html: the raw markup

url.description: The page to fetch: an http or https URL

name: fetch_url
title: Fetch a page
